items.quote: Answer format: @removed_outliers_count[count] where "count" is a non-negative integer representing the number of data points removed as outliers.
items.description: 答案檔存在且 @removed_outliers_count 為單一非負整數（格式）

items.quote: Identify and remove any outliers (data points with a Z-score greater than 3 or less than -3).

recompute.note: Z=(x-mean)/sd，sd 用母體標準差(ddof=0)；|Z|>3 的點數；空白/不可解析不算。ddof=1 給同一結果（已核）

items.description: 答案值必須等於對凍結資料的公開規則重算；重算值不進證據（防洩漏）
